decisions.reason: The accelerator program is a low-cost option that is still prominent on the home page and gives the firm access to many further green-tech options, so keeping it open is worthwhile while its value remains uncertain.

The bio-based bitumen binder is a distant but potentially high-value option with unresolved uncertainty, and keeping a dedicated page costs little, so it stays open even though it lies outside the firm's core machinery business.

The infectious waste decontamination plant is close to the core business, is backed by a partnership with ERMAFA, and was featured on the home page in both years as a lead product, signalling positive early results that justify further commitment.
